venue.name: YMCA / YWCA Westhills
venue.description: The Westhills Y is a membership recreation centre at 1319 Westhills Drive in Langford, with a pool, fitness space, activity rooms and a bookable gym. Everything it publishes for children is membership based: childminding for ages 0 to 9 where a parent stays in the building, drop in recreation such as Create and Play for ages 5 to 12, family playground sessions with a bounce house, swim lessons, and Home Alone and Babysitter courses. Children need an active Y membership to take part, adults sign them in and out, and children must be toilet trained. Nothing on the site is offered as a bookable visit for a school class or a daycare group, and the organisation's school and group outdoor education runs at its Camp Thunderbird outdoor centre near Sooke instead.
restrictions: Children must have an active Y membership to participate.
Adults are required to sign child(ren) in and out of programs. Children must be toilet trained.
Y childminding programs require a parent/guardian remain in the building at all times. Both the child and parent/guardian must be Y members.
All children under the age of 10 must be accompanied by a responsible adult 16+years of age at all times in the pool.
In the pool, children under 7 years must be within arm's reach of an adult at all times, maximum 3:1 ratio. Children 7 to 9 years need an adult on the deck viewing area, maximum 8:1 ratio.
There is no smoking anywhere on Y property. This includes parking lots.
Food is permitted only in the lobby.
venue.hours_notes: Monday to Friday 6:00am to 9:00pm. Saturday 7:30am to 6:00pm. Sunday 7:30am to 5:00pm. Closed statutory holidays, including Good Friday and Easter Monday. Phone calls are taken Monday to Friday 8:05am to 3:25pm.

images.alt: Five adults holding pickleball paddles stand behind a net in a gym with a pale block wall.

gaps: NOTHING BOOKABLE FOUND: this location publishes no field trip, no school program, no group rate, no facility rental and no birthday booking. The only bookable space is Activity Room 3, and that is reserved in 30 minute slots by an individual member through their online reservation system, not by a group. A search of their own site for school groups and for rentals returns nothing for this branch.
PRICE: no admission price of any kind is published for this location. Access to children's programming runs through Y membership, and membership prices are only shown inside their online portal.

AGE: children's programming is described as ages 0 to 12, with childminding for ages 0 to 9 and Create and Play for ages 5 to 12. No youngest age for a visiting group is published because no group visit is published.
CAPACITY, LEAD TIME, LUNCH SPACE, WASHROOMS, RAIN BACKUP: none of these are stated, because the site does not treat this location as somewhere a group books a visit.
ACCESSIBILITY: no step free, stroller or wheelchair information is published for this branch.
PARKING: the site says the Westhills Y has large public parking lots available to members, with no parking pass or licence plate registration needed. Nothing is said about where a bus would park.
The pool supervision ratios recorded here are set for the whole organisation and appear on a page shared by both recreation centres, so they apply at the Downtown Y as well as here.
The children's recreation programs listed on their site are shared between this branch and the Downtown Y, and the site says to check the online calendar for which ones actually run here.

IMAGES: the photograph used is the banner from the Westhills recreation programs page and carries no alt text on the site, so the alt line was written after opening the image in a browser and looking at it. It shows adults rather than children, which is what the page offers.

This is one of three separate records for the YMCA-YWCA of Vancouver Island. The Downtown Y in Victoria is the same kind of membership centre. All of the organisation's school and group outdoor education runs at Camp Thunderbird near Sooke, which has its own record.

COORDINATES: the Google map on their Westhills contact page carries only the centre of the map view, with no pin on the building. The point we had, 48.44624 and -123.53614, was that view centre. It has been cleared. The address stands and the coordinates still need to be worked out from it.
